description: Create an immutable payout instruction with recipient, amount_usdc, idempotency_key, memo and rail_reference. Enforces the configured 25.00 USDC per-payout cap and 100.00 USDC daily cap before accepting. Returns created with a signed receipt. No money moves. POST /api/payout-create. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base mainnet using x402 exact, under the existing shared 10 signed-wallet free calls over rolling 30 days. Every call requires X-Wever-Wallet-Proof bound to the exact JSON arguments and this API path, including paid calls. The tool fee is separate from the payout amount and grants no disbursement authority. The operator manually funds the dedicated hot payout wallet; Ledger keys never reach the server, and sweep and reclaim remain manual. No private keys are accepted. A disbursement primitive, not a bank: no yield, conversion or fiat. External custody and security audit required before large-value use. Company-authored; usage remains explicitly labeled. Read /api/payout-contract for exact schemas and authorization flow.
